notes: All load-bearing steps proving the requested identity are valid. The inter-axis distance is established geometrically, avoiding the documented pitfall. Nonessential Remark 2 needs finite inertia: masses n^{-3} at each of (±n,0,0), n≥1, have finite mass and first moment, but both the z-axis and its unit translate have inertia ∞, contradicting strict minimality. This remark is not used in the theorem's proof.
